scope: Shared terrain response and canonical tiled landscape traversal; excludes full production UI and other renderer routes

findings.finding: Terrain admission frames determine this traversal p95 failure
findings.trigger: One admitted detailed terrain tile during camera traversal
findings.amplification: 15 admissions among 179 measured frames; all 15 exceed 33ms, accounting for 15 of 17 over-budget frames. The 164 nonadmission frames have p95 16.67ms.
findings.owner: PhotorealTiledTerrain.install and first render of its admitted mesh
findings.acceptance: Unchanged canonical hardware traversal <=33ms p95, warm admission <=100ms, unchanged exact material/region/water snapshots
findings.disposition: Fixed by one shared material per tiled world. Hardware p95 and admissionMax both16.67ms; all unchanged acceptance checks pass.

findings.finding: Fresh materials miss Three node-builder identity cache while shader programs can reuse generated source
findings.trigger: createLandscapeGroundMesh creates an identical TSL graph for each admitted tile
findings.evidence: Installed Three r185 NodeMaterial.customProgramCacheKey includes child Node.getCacheKey; default Node.customCacheKey returns node.id. NodeManager.getForRender caches generated builder state by this key. Pipelines.getForRender separately caches GPU programs by shader source. profile-summary.json and admission-before.cpuprofile.gz retain measured attribution.
findings.amplification: One fresh material graph and potential node-builder compilation per admitted tile; at most coarse plus resident tile count concurrently.
findings.acceptance: Attribute admission CPU samples to node-builder work before proposing material sharing
findings.disposition: CPU profile attributes559.295ms to NodeBuilder versus152.926ms to tile install across15 admissions. Material sharing removes the repeated graph build from admission; GPU program caching alone did not avoid the CPU work.

dismissals.candidate: Skip fracture noise when exact slope/rock/minification contribution is zero
dismissals.result: p95 worsened from33.33ms to50ms; admissionMax33.335ms to83.33ms. Candidate reverted; no losing patch retained.
dismissals.shaderProof: 81 fract instructions moved inside one condition; no fwidth/dpdx/dpdy inside branch. Appearance was not accepted or baselined.

dismissals.candidate: Replace terrain shadow material color calculation
dismissals.result: Generated shadow shader contains noise but output reads constant alpha; backend dead-code elimination may remove it. Source size alone is not measured GPU work. Three castShadowNode still multiplies colorNode.a and requires transmitted shadow mode; no justified shadow contract change.

changes: Material construction separated from mesh construction. Tiled world owns one material, geometry decorators cannot mutate it, and eviction disposes geometry only. Campaign fog/territory shader composed once; per-mesh fog attributes remain independent. All material/geometry visual math and thresholds unchanged.

validation.tests: 2 focused memory/material lifecycle tests passed; old per-tile disposal mutation fails lifecycle check (1 release where0 expected)
validation.canonicalSwiftShader: Seven existing material/ramp/regional/water snapshots match exactly; no baseline changes
validation.matchedTiledHardware: Four before/candidate tiled captures have zero differing RGBA pixels; inspect tiled-comparison.json
validation.extraCanonicalTraversal: Not claimed passing: overview differs45,951pixels from historical baseline; subsequent Alps capture blank and route hook disappeared. Existing baselines not refreshed. Matched prechange/candidate hardware control instead isolates material sharing and is exact.
validation.review: Independent Codex review found old constructor argument in existing memory test; migrated and typecheck/focused tests pass. No other reported finding.
